budget_projection: 2 * sum(per-case maximum probe wall / probe_steps * calibration_steps) * independent calibration N; single worker; hard timeout binding
candidates: 10 common-wire simple candidates; public/pose/age each 3 prices; ignore/shuffle each price1e-5
selection: Freeze minimum mean capped completion_time, tie mean UL+DL, then case_id; separately select M0star among 10 simple, public among 3, pose among 3. Ablations exploratory. No post-outcome parameter additions.
age: Public ToM candidate values times 1/(1+mean effective peer age). Effective timestamp = eligible delivered newer summary else native ledger, age max(0,t-created). All peers except self. Does not alter positions/Planner.
shuffle: Only locally delivered, unexpired, strictly newer pose entries; fixed peer identities/timestamps, permute positions via independent domain206(seed,t,sender); never other worlds or hidden state.
compute: Fixed .001s valuation reservation per admission attempt including empty and periodic, shared CPU before that decision encoding. Process_time of select and mission CPU/wall separately recorded. Assumed service cost, not hardware model or full deployment CPU accounting.
cost_support: Report raw discrete mean UL+DL and CPU frontiers. A pair supports cost comparison only if both mean resource ratios lie in [0.95,1.05]; no interpolation or same-price equivalence. Finite grid can give no overlap.
stop: No-Go if primary mean task gain<=0 and either cost ratio>1.05, no joint resource support, degenerate variance or planning N>200. Any contract/source/ledger/fingerprint failure stops dependencies. No expanding N or training to rescue results.
limitations: 12-world exploratory calibration, finite price/periodic grid, one Planner search CPU/channel scenario. New service protocol, not author historical reproduction. No confirmatory superiority or deployment claim.
